description: When a chat starts, one line: Ultimatum's version, that it works, and whether the chat is held to 200K tokens (ULTIMATUM_START=0 turns it off). After a compaction, print the saved handoff back into the chat. On Stop, record local usage observations (counts only, nothing printed; ULTIMATUM_OBSERVE=0 turns it off). Before each prompt, one short line: plain questions get Ultimatum's answer style (ULTIMATUM_STYLE=0 drops it), coding work goes to /ultimatum:work, and website work goes to /ultimatum:website (ULTIMATUM_AUTO=0 turns it all off). Also the chat-size guard, off unless ULTIMATUM_GUARD=1; see the plugin README.
